question: 单价最高的商品卖了多少件
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id join orders o on oi.order_id = o.order_id where o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.product_id ORDER BY p.price DESC LIMIT 1
raw_output:
SELECT p.product_name,
       COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = '已完成' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_sold
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.product_id = (
    SELECT product_id
    FROM products
    ORDER BY price DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name;
